name: afterhours-escalation
description: After-hours maintenance escalation system with AI-powered emergency detection

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai-service && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8083
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
